knowledge_gaps: The proposal does not specify the supplied NextItNet’s receptive field or history-length distribution. Retaining 8–32 items may remove context outside the final prediction’s receptive field, while still changing supervision at earlier positions. Recency improvement therefore remains an unverified mechanism.

Cropping also removes supervised positions and changes their weighting. A gain could arise from reduced supervision or stronger emphasis on later targets. A matched loss-masking control is needed to distinguish these effects. Specify augmentation RNG isolation, loss normalization, short-history behavior, and padding checks.

The experiment lacks a bounded comparison and diagnostic protocol within the shared GPU budget. Define the baseline comparison, paired uncertainty on fixed validation candidates, diagnostic sampling and unavailable-value handling. Originality and difficulty scores are plausible informal judgments; the potential score lacks measured support.
